note: Mission voice casting for scripts/audio/generate-voices.ts. Only ElevenLabs premade (ElevenLabs-owned) voices are cast: no community or cloned voice, so no real person's likeness. The player stays silent (subtitles only).

account.basis: ElevenLabs help centre, 'Can I publish the content I generate on the platform?': the free plan includes no commercial licence and may not be used for any commercial purpose (attribution does not change that); every paid plan includes a commercial licence (Beta services excepted). https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/en-us/articles/13313564601361

hold: Voice generation is held: the ElevenLabs account is on the free tier, which grants no commercial licence, so its output cannot ship in a distributed game. Upgrade to any paid tier, then run `node scripts/audio/generate-voices.ts --generate`. Until then every mission line plays as timed subtitles.
